search_question: Does an authoritative public object supply an independently reconstructible HUST-2018 harmonic remainder, its full physical source maps, or the campaign raw/correction/covariance packet?

search_evidence_scope.ceiling: Zero-root assertions for aggregate index-mediated entries are dated curator records, not executable completeness certificates.

surfaces.mode: direct article and associated-object inventory inspection
surfaces.result: Seven associated public objects: Supplementary Information; Supplementary Data for Supplementary Fig. 1; Source Data for Figs. 2 and 3; Source Data for Extended Data Figs. 2, 4 and 5.
surfaces.reason: All seven objects were previously inventoried by the HUST dual-method forward lane; only its locally acquired subset is hash-pinned as binaries. None of the seven inventoried release objects contains the full requested maps or raw/correction/covariance packet.

surfaces.result: The article states that data supporting the findings are available from the corresponding authors on reasonable request.
surfaces.reason: An on-request statement is an acquisition route, not a publicly inspectable payload.

surfaces.mode: exact DOI metadata and relation inspection
surfaces.result: The relation object was empty; no related dataset DOI was registered.
surfaces.reason: No dataset relation was exposed by this registry record.

surfaces.result: Three records were returned; all were 2026 works by Ali Attar that reference the HUST DOI, not HUST-author/institution campaign-data deposits.
surfaces.reason: Citation relation and unrelated provenance fail the admission rule.

surfaces.mode: exact resource_doi POST to both literal endpoints
surfaces.result: Empty article result and empty collection result.
surfaces.reason: No exact resource-DOI deposit was returned.

surfaces.result: Two later 2026 records were returned; both merely reference the HUST paper and are not HUST campaign deposits.
surfaces.reason: Unrelated provenance and no requested campaign payload.

surfaces.query_or_url: dryad.org and osf.io exact DOI/title domain searches
surfaces.mode: index-mediated domain-restricted exact DOI and exact-title searches
surfaces.result: No relevant HUST campaign deposit was located.
surfaces.reason: No candidate payload reached admission review; index-mediated discovery is not asserted exhaustive.

surfaces.result: No relevant HUST campaign-data object was located.
surfaces.reason: No candidate numeric payload reached admission review; discovery is bounded to the named surfaces.

surfaces.mode: direct inspection of the two named literal URLs only
surfaces.result: Official bibliographic/news pages link to the Nature article but expose no additional data attachment.
No relevant author/team campaign repository was located.

surfaces.mode: campaign-author, method and title searches; HUST library discovery inspection
surfaces.result: One confirmed campaign dissertation lead was found: Jun-Fei Wu's 2021 HUST AAF doctoral dissertation. One additional high-Q-silica-fibre ToS title string is an unverified bibliographic lead only; the discoverable metadata do not authenticate author, institution, year or document type. No openly inspectable payload was located.
surfaces.reason: Catalogue metadata alone cannot establish the presence or values of the missing numeric maps/raw packet.

bounded_conclusion: Within the explicitly named public surfaces queried on 2026-08-27, no publicly inspectable object satisfying the completion-root admission rule was located.
non_exhaustive_ceiling: This result does not establish that the requested data do not exist, are absent from all public surfaces, or cannot be recovered from authors, institutional/subscription holdings, or future releases.
